options.content: Per-frame stage durations plus cumulative milestone offsets. The cumulative charts reconstruct pipeline output times from diagnostics timings; orderbook-relative milestones use local `orderbook_timestamp_ms`, frame-relative milestones use local `t_end_ms`. Raw adapter receive lag stays on Prometheus because raw market events are not persisted by default.

targets.rawSql:
WITH market AS (
  SELECT
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(m.t_end_ms / 1000.0))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
    (m.exchange || ' ' || m.symbol || ' ') || s.metric AS metric,
    s.value AS value
  FROM mm_market_facts m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      ('market.orderbook_age_at_frame_close', GREATEST((m.t_end_ms - m.orderbook_timestamp_ms)::double precision, 0.0)),
      ('market.frame_persist_lag', GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (m.ts - to_timestamp(m.t_end_ms / 1000.0))) * 1000.0, 0.0))
  ) AS s(metric, value)
  WHERE m.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND m.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND m.orderbook_timestamp_ms IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(m.ts)
),
controller AS (
  SELECT
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
    (e.actor_id || ' ' || e.exchange || ' ' || e.symbol || ' ') || s.metric AS metric,
    CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(s.raw_value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(s.raw_value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE(s.unit, 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(s.raw_value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(s.raw_value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(s.raw_value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(s.raw_value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      ('frame.age_at_strategy', e.payload #>> ARRAY['frame','frame_age_ms'], 'ms'),
      ('frame.global_lag', e.payload #>> ARRAY['frame','global_lag_ms'], 'ms'),
      ('strategy.clean', e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','clean_ms'], 'ms'),
      ('strategy.decide_total', e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','decide_ms'], 'ms'),
      ('strategy.optimizer_sample_draw', e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','sample_draw_sec'], 'sec'),
      ('strategy.optimizer_train_loop', e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','train_sec'], 'sec'),
      ('strategy.optimizer_total', e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','total_sec'], 'sec'),
      ('strategy.risk', e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','risk_ms'], 'ms'),
      ('strategy.publish', e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], 'ms'),
      ('execution.cancel', e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], 'ms'),
      ('execution.place', e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], 'ms'),
      ('execution.sync', e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','execute_ms'], 'ms'),
      ('controller.total', e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','controller_total_ms'], 'ms')
  ) AS s(metric, raw_value, unit)
  WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
)
SELECT "time", metric, value
FROM market
WHERE value IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT "time", metric, value
FROM controller
WHERE value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH frames AS (
  SELECT
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time" AS "time",
    (e.actor_id || ' ' || e.exchange || ' ' || e.symbol || ' ') AS metric_prefix,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS t_end_ms,
    COALESCE(
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['frame','local_orderbook_timestamp_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['frame','local_orderbook_timestamp_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END,
  m.orderbook_timestamp_ms
) AS orderbook_timestamp_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['frame','frame_created_at_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['frame','frame_created_at_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS frame_created_at_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'created_at_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'created_at_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS controller_end_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','controller_total_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','controller_total_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE('ms', 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','controller_total_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','controller_total_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','controller_total_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','controller_total_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS controller_total_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','clean_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','clean_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE('ms', 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','clean_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','clean_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','clean_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','clean_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS clean_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','decide_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','decide_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE('ms', 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','decide_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','decide_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','decide_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','decide_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS decide_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','risk_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','risk_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE('ms', 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','risk_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','risk_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','risk_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','risk_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS risk_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE('ms', 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS publish_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE('ms', 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS cancel_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE('ms', 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS place_ms
  FROM mm_events e
  LEFT JOIN mm_market_facts m
    ON m.exchange = e.exchange
   AND m.symbol = e.symbol
   AND m.t_end_ms = (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END)::bigint
  WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
)
SELECT
  f."time",
  f.metric_prefix || s.metric AS metric,
  s.value AS value
FROM frames f
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
      ('+orderbook.ref', 0.0),
      ('+frame_close', f.t_end_ms - f.orderbook_timestamp_ms),
      ('+frame_assembled', f.frame_created_at_ms - f.orderbook_timestamp_ms),
      ('+strategy_start', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) - f.orderbook_timestamp_ms),
      ('+after_clean', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) - f.orderbook_timestamp_ms),
      ('+after_decide', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.decide_ms, 0) - f.orderbook_timestamp_ms),
      ('+after_risk', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.decide_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.risk_ms, 0) - f.orderbook_timestamp_ms),
      ('+after_publish', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.decide_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.risk_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.publish_ms, 0) - f.orderbook_timestamp_ms),
      ('+after_cancel', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.decide_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.risk_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.publish_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.cancel_ms, 0) - f.orderbook_timestamp_ms),
      ('+after_place', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.decide_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.risk_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.publish_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.cancel_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.place_ms, 0) - f.orderbook_timestamp_ms),
      ('+pipeline_end', f.controller_end_ms - f.orderbook_timestamp_ms)
) AS s(metric, value)
WHERE f.orderbook_timestamp_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND s.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1, 2

  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','risk_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','risk_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','risk_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','risk_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS risk_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE('ms', 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','publish_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS publish_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE('ms', 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','cancel_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS cancel_ms,
    CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE('ms', 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','timing','place_ms'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS place_ms
  FROM mm_events e
  LEFT JOIN mm_market_facts m
    ON m.exchange = e.exchange
   AND m.symbol = e.symbol
   AND m.t_end_ms = (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END)::bigint
  WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
)
SELECT
  f."time",
  f.metric_prefix || s.metric AS metric,
  s.value AS value
FROM frames f
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
      ('+frame_close.ref', 0.0),
      ('+frame_assembled', f.frame_created_at_ms - f.t_end_ms),
      ('+strategy_start', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) - f.t_end_ms),
      ('+after_clean', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) - f.t_end_ms),
      ('+after_decide', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.decide_ms, 0) - f.t_end_ms),
      ('+after_risk', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.decide_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.risk_ms, 0) - f.t_end_ms),
      ('+after_publish', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.decide_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.risk_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.publish_ms, 0) - f.t_end_ms),
      ('+after_cancel', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.decide_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.risk_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.publish_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.cancel_ms, 0) - f.t_end_ms),
      ('+after_place', (f.controller_end_ms - f.controller_total_ms) + COALESCE(f.clean_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.decide_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.risk_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.publish_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.cancel_ms, 0) + COALESCE(f.place_ms, 0) - f.t_end_ms),
      ('+pipeline_end', f.controller_end_ms - f.t_end_ms)
) AS s(metric, value)
WHERE f.t_end_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND s.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  (e.actor_id || ' ' || e.exchange || ' ' || e.symbol || ' ') || s.metric AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(s.raw_value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(s.raw_value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NULL THEN NULL
  WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE(s.unit, 'ms'))) = 'sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(s.raw_value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'

FROM mm_events e

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gates.key AS exchange
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND gates.key IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange'] AS exchange
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange'] AS exchange
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
) x
WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
ORDER BY 1
